0.original: The wounded Resistance fighter has a lot on his mind.

24.original: Deliver the bloody bandana to the Resistance fighter's mother in Ala Gannha.

48.original: There is something I would ask of you, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>.

49.original: I joined the Resistance against my mother's wishes. She awaits me back in my hometown.

50.original: I'm lucky to still be here after that last battle and I don't want to take her love for granted anymore.

51.original: Please, deliver this bandana to Mother in Ala Gannha on my behalf.

52.original: And tell her that I said “Thank you.” I want her to know I understand why she objected to me joining the fight against the Empire.

53.original: Please, deliver this bandana to Mother in Ala Gannha on my behalf. And tell her of my gratitude.

55.original: Wh-Why, this is my boy's! Has something happened to him!?

56.original: Thank heavens. He is still safe. I tried to dissuade him from joining the Resistance, but he would not listen. We had a big fight and he wound up sneaking out in the dead of night.

57.original: It is a weight off my mind to learn that he does not resent me. However, the fact he has returned this bandana must mean he intends to continue fighting.

58.original: If his resolve is truly that strong then there is little chance of me convincing him to come home. I will continue to pray for his safe return.
